name: MOOSE blinded refactor comparison (codeQA)

on:
  push:
    branches: [experiment/moose-refactor-comparison-20261023]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout codeQA experiment (not production)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: codeqa
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout MOOSE identical baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: HyungseonSong-plasma/moose-test-repo
          ref: 69be07aab3e5815a1670f7308deb6caf6b49bc79
          path: base
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout blind branch frozen before any codeQA analysis
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: HyungseonSong-plasma/moose-test-repo
          ref: 44bed71f3bb898c099650afa011e8485fa59cb18
          path: blind
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout codeQA-informed refactor from the identical baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: HyungseonSong-plasma/moose-test-repo
          ref: 4f4f4bc935615811ebbb6f9dc37faadc04ca6e79
          path: informed
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install codeQA only
        run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -e ./codeqa
      - name: Static codeQA analysis; inspect only frozen ci/guards Python scope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          from codeqa.infrastructure.resources import ResourceRegistry
          from codeqa.pipeline.python import analyze_python
          from codeqa.adapters.python_snapshot import parse_python_snapshot
          from codeqa.adapters.python_complexity import extract_python_complexity
          from codeqa.adapters.python_duplication import extract_python_token_blocks
          from codeqa.evaluation.complexity import ComplexityProfile, evaluate_complexity
          from codeqa.evaluation.duplication import DuplicationProfile, evaluate_duplication
          from codeqa.evaluation.qa_result import mechanical_to_qa_result
          from codeqa.evaluation.mechanical import MechanicalProfile
          from codeqa.evaluation.dependency_metrics import DependencyMetricsProfile, evaluate_dependency_metrics
          from codeqa.evaluation.quality_delta_companions import (
              complexity_metric_rules, dependency_metric_rule, duplication_metric_rule,
          )
          from codeqa.evaluation.quality_delta_v02 import (
              metric_snapshot_from_qa_result, build_source_change_manifest,
              compare_metric_snapshots,
          )
          root = Path("codeqa")
          registry = ResourceRegistry(root)
          repo = "HyungseonSong-plasma/moose-test-repo"
          target = "ci/guards/physics_dependency_guard.py"
          sha = {
              "base": "69be07aab3e5815a1670f7308deb6caf6b49bc79",
              "blind": "44bed71f3bb898c099650afa011e8485fa59cb18",
              "informed": "4f4f4bc935615811ebbb6f9dc37faadc04ca6e79",
          }
          output, snapshots = {}, {}
          for name, revision in sha.items():
              directory = Path(name)
              files = {
                  p.relative_to(directory).as_posix(): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                  for p in sorted((directory / "ci/guards").glob("*.py"))
              }
              if len(files) < 12 or target not in files:
                  raise RuntimeError("fixed guard selection unexpectedly empty")
              snap = "git:" + repo + "@" + revision
              mechanical = registry.load_json("mechanical_profile")
              cprofile = ComplexityProfile.from_mapping(registry.load_json("complexity_profile"))
              dconf = registry.load_json("duplication_profile")
              dprofile = DuplicationProfile.from_mapping(dconf)
              dep_profile = DependencyMetricsProfile.from_mapping(
                  registry.load_json("dependency_metrics_profile"))
              analysis = analyze_python(files, snapshot_id=snap,
                  ccg_schema=registry.load_json("ccg_schema"),
                  mechanical_profile=mechanical)
              parsed = parse_python_snapshot(files)
              comp = evaluate_complexity(analysis.graph,
                  extract_python_complexity(parsed), cprofile)
              dup = evaluate_duplication(extract_python_token_blocks(
                  parsed, files, snapshot_id=snap, profile=dconf), dprofile)
              dependency = evaluate_dependency_metrics(analysis.dependencies, dep_profile)
              qa = mechanical_to_qa_result(analysis.graph, analysis.quality,
                  MechanicalProfile.from_mapping(mechanical),
                  schema=registry.load_json("qa_result_schema"))
              snapshots[name] = metric_snapshot_from_qa_result(
                  qa, files, repository=repo, commit_sha=revision,
                  result_schema=registry.load_json("qa_result_schema"),
                  snapshot_schema=registry.load_json("metric_snapshot_v02_schema"),
                  companions=(
                      *complexity_metric_rules(comp, cprofile),
                      duplication_metric_rule(dup, dprofile),
                      dependency_metric_rule(dependency, dep_profile),
                  ),
              )
              comp_by_id = {
                  x.node_id: x for x in comp.reviews if x.path == target
              }
              calls_by_id = {x.node_id: x.call_sites for x in analysis.quality.call_metrics}
              target_functions = []
              for node in analysis.graph.nodes:
                  if node.kind not in ("function", "method") or not node.location:
                      continue
                  if node.location.path != target:
                      continue
                  rev = comp_by_id.get(node.id)
                  target_functions.append({
                      "id": node.id,
                      "name": node.name,
                      "span": node.location.end_line-node.location.start_line+1,
                      "outgoing_ast_call_sites": calls_by_id.get(node.id),
                      "complexity_proxy": rev.cyclomatic_proxy if rev else None,
                      "max_nesting": rev.branch_nesting_max if rev else None,
                      "complexity_state": rev.status if rev else "UNAVAILABLE",
                  })
              output[name] = {
                  "source_sha": revision,
                  "coverage": analysis.graph.coverage.status,
                  "files_selected": len(files),
                  "mechanical_status": analysis.quality.status,
                  "mechanical_limitations": list(analysis.quality.analysis_limitations),
                  "mechanical_review_count": len(analysis.quality.findings),
                  "duplication_fraction": dup.observed_duplicate_fraction,
                  "duplication_limitations": list(dup.not_evaluated),
                  "complexity_review_count": sum(
                      x.status == "REVIEW_REQUIRED" for x in comp.reviews),
                  "unknown_static_imports": dict(dependency.unknown_by_reason),
                  "target_functions": sorted(target_functions, key=lambda x:x["name"]),
              }
          output["comparisons"] = {}
          for source_label, target_label in (
              ("base", "blind"), ("base", "informed"), ("blind", "informed")
          ):
              delta = compare_metric_snapshots(
                  snapshots[source_label], snapshots[target_label],
                  build_source_change_manifest(
                      snapshots[source_label], snapshots[target_label]),
                  snapshot_schema=registry.load_json("metric_snapshot_v02_schema"),
                  change_schema=registry.load_json("source_change_v02_schema"),
                  delta_schema=registry.load_json("qa_delta_v02_schema"),
              )
              output["comparisons"][source_label + "_vs_" + target_label] = {
                  "overall_status": delta["status"],
                  "rules": {
                      r["rule_id"]: {
                          "status":r["status"], "sum_delta":r["sum_delta"],
                          "review_delta":r["review_delta"],"reasons":r["reasons"],
                      } for r in delta["rule_deltas"]
                  },
              }
          import difflib
          baseline = (Path("base") / target).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
          for label in ("blind", "informed"):
              candidate = (Path(label) / target).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
              opcodes = difflib.SequenceMatcher(
                  a=baseline, b=candidate, autojunk=False).get_opcodes()
              output[label]["changed_source_lines"] = {
                  "baseline_lines": len(baseline), "candidate_lines": len(candidate),
                  "added": sum(j2-j1 for tag,i1,i2,j1,j2 in opcodes
                               if tag in ("insert","replace")),
                  "removed": sum(i2-i1 for tag,i1,i2,j1,j2 in opcodes
                                 if tag in ("delete","replace")),
              }
          print("CODEQA_EXPERIMENT_RESULTS_BEGIN")
          print(json.dumps(output, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
          print("CODEQA_EXPERIMENT_RESULTS_END")
          PY
      - name: Independent source-only differential behavior regression
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util
          import io
          from contextlib import redirect_stdout
          from pathlib import Path
          from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

          versions = {}
          for label in ("base", "blind", "informed"):
              file = Path(label) / "ci/guards/physics_dependency_guard.py"
              spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
                  "refactor_guard_" + label, file,
              )
              module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
              spec.loader.exec_module(module)
              versions[label] = module

          cases = [
              {},
              {"a": set()},
              {"a": {"a"}},
              {"a": {"b"}, "b": {"c"}, "c": {"a"}},
              {"a": {"b"}, "b": {"c"}, "c": set()},
              {"c": {"b"}, "a": {"b"}, "b": {"c"}},
              {"z": {"missing"}, "b": {"c"}, "c": {"b"}},
          ]
          import_names = [
              "physics_harness.evidence.a", "physics_harness.analysis.b",
              "physics_harness.execution.c", "physics_harness.cli.d",
              "physics_harness.validation.e", "physics_harness.inventory.x",
              "physics_harness.dmix.y", "ci.utility", "external.tool",
          ]
          with TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
              source = Path(temp) / "fixture.py"
              source.write_text(
                  "import physics_harness.evidence.a, ci.utility\n"
                  "from physics_harness.analysis import b\n"
                  "from .relative import ignored\n"
                  "from ci.helpers import x\n"
                  "import external.tool\n"
                  "label = 'ci/guards/something'\n",
                  encoding="utf-8",
              )
              reference = versions["base"]
              for label, m in versions.items():
                  assert m.imported_modules(source) == reference.imported_modules(source), label
                  assert m.repository_ci_references() == reference.repository_ci_references(), label
                  assert m.audit() == reference.audit(), label
                  for graph in cases:
                      assert m.find_cycle(graph) == reference.find_cycle(graph), (label, graph)
                  for src in import_names:
                      for dst in import_names:
                          assert m.violation(src, dst) == reference.violation(src, dst), (label, src, dst)
              print("DIFFERENTIAL_BEHAVIOR_EQUIVALENCE_PASS: 3 arms / 7 graphs / 81 policy pairs")
          PY
      - name: Run all three dependency guards (not physics solver)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          for folder in base blind informed; do
            echo "GUARD_$folder"
            (cd "$folder" && python3 ci/guards/physics_dependency_guard.py --check all)
          done
